patch.patched_dockerfile:
FROM python:3.11-slim
RUN groupadd -r appuser && useradd -r -g appuser appuser
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY --chown=appuser:appuser . .
USER appuser
EXPOSE 5000
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
